# Civorax Group (Civorax)

> Civorax Group is a premier technology, software development, and infrastructure holding company in Nepal, founded in 2019 and headquartered at Itahari-04, Aaitabare, NTC Road, Sunsari, Koshi Province, Nepal. It is the parent entity of two major subsidiaries: CivoraX Tech Pvt. Ltd. (civoraxtech.com) and CivoraX Infra Pvt. Ltd. (civoraxinfra.com).

- **Brand & Entity Names**: Civorax Group, Civorax, CivoraX, CivoraxTech, Civorax Tech, CivoraxInfra, CivoraX Infra.
- **Slogan**: "The architecture of tomorrow."
- **Meaning**: Civ (Civilization) + Aura (Energy & Spirit) + X (The Future). Connecting civilization with energy and carrying it into tomorrow through tech and infrastructure.
- **Location**: Itahari-04, Aaitabare, NTC Road, Sunsari, Koshi Province, Nepal.
- **Service Regions**: Itahari, Biratnagar, Dharan, Kathmandu, Pokhara, Koshi Province, and across Nepal.

## Entity Disambiguation
- Civorax Group is an independent group of companies operating in Nepal. It is **not** affiliated with Civora Nexus or third-party internship programs of similar names.
